root/proof/theorem9-cited-premise-founda.title: Proof of the conditional Theorem 9 specialization and marginalization
root/proof/theorem9-cited-premise-founda.summary: Proof record bounded to `root/result/theorem9-cited-premise-foundations`. Starting from the explicitly assumed Theorem 9 system, the proof sets R0=0, expands each minimum and both interval side conditions, and compares the resulting 30 rows term by term with an independently generated three-receiver-path system. It exhaustively audits the output-bearing information terms and uses their single-output form to show that replacing an arbitrary admitted auxiliary-receiver law by the product of its input-conditioned G and K marginals preserves every row and side condition. It then applies the premise's stated quantifier and optimization order to obtain the conditional capacity inequality, obtains V_Q(G,K) <= V(1/2;G,K) <= B(G,K) by restriction and definition, and uses posterior mutual-information identities on Q0={0,1/2,1} to establish the accepted dependence and finiteness statement for V_0(g,k). This proof does not authenticate or re-prove the cited Theorem 9 premise and establishes no numerical bound, receiver-cardinality theorem, or continuum limit.

root/result/theorem9-cited-premise-found.title: Conditional Theorem 9 private-message foundations
root/result/theorem9-cited-premise-found.summary:
Assume the cited Gohari--Liu--Nair Theorem 9 outer-bound premise exactly as encoded in theorem9_spec.json and displayed for review in SOURCE_TRANSCRIPTION.md: for every finite auxiliary-receiver law T_{G,K|X,Y,Z}, achievable rates obey the stated factorization, equations (19a)-(19p), and both side conditions. Then setting R0=0 and exhaustively expanding the displayed minima and interval conditions gives exactly the independently generated local 30-row system; the exhaustive single-output term audit proves that replacing G,K by their input-only product marginals preserves the entire system, and hence for the physical BSSC C_sum <= inf_{finite-output binary-input T_{G|X},T_{K|X}} B(G,K). With the explicit extended-real local definitions (including sup(empty set)=-infinity), V_Q(G,K) <= V(1/2;G,K) <= B(G,K), and every Q0-supported row depends on the receiver channels only through (c,g,k,c), making V_0(g,k) finite and well defined on its realizable (g,k)-domain. No PDF-origin, source-fidelity, rendering, or visual-semantic assertion is part of this claim.

Scope qualifications:
- The verdict does not authenticate the external theorem, manuscript, PDF, transcription provenance, rendering, or source fidelity.
- The equality attestation is limited to syntactic and algebraic equality of the pinned encoded systems.
- The product-marginal reduction relies on the audited system containing only single-output G or K information terms, with no joint (G,K) term and no conditioning of one receiver output on another.
- The capacity conclusion is conditional on the premise's quantifier structure: one prior for each achievable rate pair works for every finite auxiliary-receiver law, with an appropriate finite hierarchy for each law.
- Finiteness and well-definedness of V_0(g,k) are asserted only on the realizable (g,k)-domain.

The tool is corroborative and is not an independently accepted mathematical claim or a reinterpretation of an execution attestation.
